name: Recharge AI-task
summary: Continue selected AI tasks after AI provider token quota recovery
description: Continue selected AI tasks after their usage limits reset. Supports OpenAI Codex, Claude Code and Meta (Facebook) Muse Code, plus OpenCode in wrapped interactive terminals. Includes a Linux dashboard, system tray and CLI (terminal commands).

Choose desktop recipients and continuation messages, monitor supported provider quotas and recovery times, or wrap a provider CLI in a terminal. Codex chats also support Goal recovery. Provider tools must be installed and signed in separately.
OpenCode continuation requires a terminal usage-limit message with a supported explicit reset time. OpenCode shared quota checks, dashboard chat recipients and Goal actions are unavailable.
